name: ai-kanban
description: A kanban board an agent uses as persistent memory: what is in flight, what happened and why, and what was learned about the codebase -- surviving across sessions.

relay_url.title: Team relay URL (optional)
relay_url.description: Only to share boards with a team through an ai-kanban relay, e.g. https://kanban.example.com. Leave empty and ai-kanban stays on this machine.

relay_key.title: Team relay key (optional)
relay_key.description: This machine's key from the relay admin. Kept in your system keychain, never in a file you share.

relay_name.title: Your name on the team relay (optional)
relay_name.description: How your teammates see you. Left empty, the relay gives you one like brave-otter. Change it here any time; your task numbers stay the same.
